name: waptions

scripts.cf-preview: opennextjs-cloudflare build -e preview && opennextjs-cloudflare preview -e preview
scripts.cf-deploy-preview: opennextjs-cloudflare build -e preview && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy -e preview
scripts.cf-deploy-production: opennextjs-cloudflare build -e production && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy -e production
scripts.test:tooling: node --test scripts/build-agent-plugin.test.mjs scripts/check-coverage-baseline.test.mjs scripts/media-tooling.test.mjs scripts/next-config.test.mjs scripts/process-lifecycle.test.mjs scripts/e2e/diarization-secret-artifacts.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage:critical: vitest run --config vitest.critical.config.ts --coverage && node scripts/check-coverage-baseline.mjs --profile critical-runtime
scripts.test:coverage:critical:update: vitest run --config vitest.critical.config.ts --coverage && node scripts/check-coverage-baseline.mjs --profile critical-runtime --update
scripts.test:e2e:full: pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run test:report
scripts.test:verify: pnpm run fixtures:media:verify && pnpm run test:tooling && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:coverage:critical && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build:verify && pnpm run test:e2e:diarization-security && pnpm run test:e2e:verify
